name: agy-chat-migration
description: Universal toolkit and runbook for migrating, relinking, adopting, splitting, and synchronizing Antigravity conversations and projects across directories, projects, editions (IDE/Desktop/CLI), and operating systems (Windows/Linux/macOS).
suggestedPrompts: Audit this Antigravity project and its conversations before migrating or moving it
Find unbound Outside-of-Project or legacy IDE chats and move them into a target project
Export this project's conversation capsule and show how to import and relink it on another machine
